content: वार्त्रघ्नीन्यायः (Mīmāṃsā) A rule of interpretation according to which a detail that cannot properly find connection with the primary or main matter should be understood as belonging to a subsidiary thereof. This is an exception to the मिथोऽसम्बन्धन्याय (<ab>q. v.</ab>). This is discussed by Jaimini and Śabara at <ls>MS. 3. 1. 23</ls>.
